vector_search_sql.create_extension: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector;
vector_search_sql.create_table: CREATE TABLE resource_embeddings (id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, content TEXT NOT NULL, embedding VECTOR(1536) NOT NULL, metadata JSONB, source_file TEXT, page_number INT, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW());
vector_search_sql.create_index: CREATE INDEX ON resource_embeddings USING ivfflat (embedding vector_cosine_ops) WITH (lists = 100);
vector_search_sql.similarity_search: SELECT content, metadata, source_file, 1 - (embedding <=> $1) AS similarity FROM resource_embeddings ORDER BY embedding <=> $1 LIMIT 5;

azure_openai_config.deployment_name: Check Azure OpenAI Studio for deployment names

chat_interface_integration.update_handleSendMessage: Replace setTimeout() with fetch('/api/chat', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ participantId, message: input }) })
chat_interface_integration.streaming_response: Use ReadableStream and update message character by character for typing effect
chat_interface_integration.error_handling: Show error toast if API fails, add retry button
